cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

mechanism: A teaches its pupil a correspondence restart while diverting from evidence that A unanswered letters created the distance.
confusable: Not openly admitting fault: A shifts from excuses to urgent demonstration without acknowledging its withdrawal.
comparison: Unanswered letters/hand delivery versus changed lock/birthday exclusion.
seedUse: D85 letters/stamps/post/handed; S05 letter-writing teaching used to bypass accountability.
